name: MOONGATE
detailed_description:
Step into MOONGATE — a remote research station for interdimensional travel. Now silent and abandoned, its portals still hum with energy, leading to unknown worlds. Enter, discover what lies beyond and unravel the fate of the station’s crew.

Features

  • Old-school FPS combat fused with dungeon-crawling exploration: Explore randomly generated dungeons and fight vile creatures using classic first-person shooter mechanics — no hand-holding, no auto-aim, no regenerating health. Just skill, strategy and old-school action.

  • Randomly-generated dungeons: No playthrough of a level will be the same as an advanced level-generator creates unique rooms, corridors and multi-floor level layouts from hand-made tilesets every time you enter.

  • A nonlinear hub full of locked doors and secrets: The hub connects your randomized runs. While dungeons reset each time, progress in the hub is permanent. Open shortcuts, find hidden powerups and unlock new areas as you bring back key items.

  • Full procedural animation: Each enemy is fully procedurally animated, enabling highly dynamic movement and interaction with the environment. Instead of relying on simple playback of premade animations, every motion — down to individual body parts — is calculated in real time using factors like velocity, damping, and frequency.

  • Gore galore: Stagger your enemies or shoot off body parts to impair their movement and abilities. All gibs and bloodstains stay on floor, leaving a visceral trail that clearly marks your conquered territory.

short_description: A retro first-person shooter inspired by classics of the '90s mixed with a dungeon crawler. Fight your way through randomly-generated dungeons and uncover the secrets of an abandoned research station for interdimensional travel.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv8 CPU (Example: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD Athlon XE BE-2300, Snapdragon X Elite)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support (Intel HD Graphics 5500 (Broadwell), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri))
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10,
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 instructions, with 4 physical cores or more, ARMv8 CPU (Example: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600, Snapdragon X Elite)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support (Example: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (Pascal), AMD Radeon RX 460 (GCN 4.0))
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: The game features blood and gore. Enemies bleed when shot and can be dismembered, leaving gibs and bloodstains on the floor.
